If the cwnd exceeds the ss_thresh, the “Congestion Avoidance” phase (2) is entered. During this phase, the cwnd is increased by 1 / cwnd per ACK (cwnd = cwnd + 1 / cwnd). Thereby, the cwnd is increased by one after all transmitted segments are ACKed (additive increase). notes.content: {"answer":"Phase 1: Slow start The basic idea behind \"slow start\" is to send packets as much as the network can accept.
